description: Verified loyalty-program coverage of this application's award providers. Populated only from evidence — never from alliance-membership inference. Evidence classes: 'observed' = seen in a real API response captured by this project; 'vendor-documented' = the vendor's own site/docs; 'secondary' = reputable third-party reporting; 'code' = what this codebase's integration actually requests.
notes: 'integrated' means THIS application's provider wrapper can return the program today. Roame is searched with mileagePrograms:[ALL], so its integrated coverage equals whatever Roame's backend searches; the vendor documents 26 programs.

The ATF integration calls 5 fixed airline endpoints (british_airways, qatar_airways, cathay_pacific, virgin_atlantic, iberia). The vendor now documents 14+ programs including flying-blue and aeroplan — expanding the integration is a known, unimplemented option.

Flying Blue is currently degraded industry-wide after its May 2025 login-wall: seats.aero reports 'Outage' and PointsYeah 'Temporary Unavailable' (both 2026-08-27). Roame still lists it as supported (re-confirmed by AwardWallet, 2026-08-02).
Lufthansa-group FIRST class partner awards ended ~2026-06-01 (secondary reporting): LH F space is now effectively Miles & More-only, so a M&M-capable source is REQUIRED for Austrian/LH/Swiss First.

roame.evidence: vendor-documented: roame.travel/programs lists 'Lufthansa Miles & More'; roame.travel/guides/lufthansa-miles-more: 'Roame now searches Lufthansa Miles & More!' (First & Business, Star Alliance partners). Not yet observed in this project's captures (no live session since the feature's addition).

MILES_AND_MORE.otherCandidates: seats.aero (source 'lufthansa', Y/J/F, live+cached, Partner API with Pro $9.99/mo, 1000 calls/day non-commercial); PointsYeah (live, commercial API by partnership); AwardTool ($10.99/mo). No official Lufthansa award API; direct scraping needs member login + 7,000-mile minimum balance.

roame.evidence: vendor-documented: roame.travel/programs lists 'Air France/KLM Flying Blue'; help.roame.travel supported-programs article (dated 2024-12-17) lists AF+KLM Flying Blue; AwardWallet review re-confirmed 2026-08-02. Also noted in this repo's CLAUDE.md as observed in Feb 2026 searches. CAVEAT: Flying Blue login-walled award search in May 2025 and is currently degraded at seats.aero and PointsYeah — treat Roame FB results with suspicion until observed live.
